## Description

Records the patient may see (signed summaries and reviewed results only, plain words, never AI drafts), prescriptions with QR, clinic messages (with the 'not for emergencies' rule), consents and family access, payment sheet (UPI, cards; Apple Pay in UAE) marked paid only when the bank or gateway confirms, receipts to Records and WhatsApp, and the video-visit join screen (camera and microphone check). Video joins only when teleconsultation (MDV-P8-002) is switched on for the clinic; until then the entry is hidden by flag.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a result is not reviewed, when the patient opens Records, then it shows as pending, not as a value.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a payment, when the bank has not confirmed, then the invoice is not marked paid.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a draft AI note exists, when the patient opens Records, then nothing of it is visible.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given video visits are not enabled for the clinic, when the patient opens the app, then no video entry is shown.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
